        bad = set()
        for o in self.req['observations'][si]:
            v = self.metric_value(si, o, qvec, loads)
            if v < o['lower'] or v > o['upper']:
                bad.add(o['domain'])

new = """    def fault_set(self, si, qvec, loads):
        \"\"\"Domains whose observations are violated by this demand vector.\"\"\"
        bad = set()
        for o in self.req['observations'][si]:
            v = self.metric_value(si, o, qvec, loads)
            if v < o['lower'] or v > o['upper']:
                if o['domain'] is not None:
                    bad.add(o['domain'])
        return bad"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
